2025-07-01.title: Couchers.org version 1.0.0 Released. We're officially out of beta!

2025-05-26: It's now possible to block users and remove friends via your "My connections" page in your profile.
2025-04-24: Introducing the Notifications Feed — so you never miss an update! Just look for the bell icon at the top right of the navigation bar.
2025-04-16: Search has been completely redesigned with more filters, layout and list-only view option!
2025-02-23: Communities now have a "Members" tab, where you can see all members of that community.
